reviews.x: Love the smell but horrible product I had to use 2 bombs just to see a color and when I was done out the tub I let the water out and it stained my bath tub has the pink rim around my tub and pink spots in the tub so um no don't buy

I bought these as a birthday gift for my wife.  they arrived on time and worked as exactly as expected. I was expecting them to be slightly bigger but with the quantity that you get it definitely out weighs the size of the product.  After my wife used the bath bomb you could clearly tell that her skin was smoother and the scent from the bath bomb lingered which was very nice.

I was really excited to try these bath bombs because I'm lush obsessed but lush is expensive! I tried to keep my standards low because obv they aren't organic or fresh but I still was disappointed. They smell like baking soda more than anything else, they're golf ball sized, and even with two in the tub you have little effect. The pink ones stained my tub too. Bummer.
Loved how they smell and look. Plus made my skin feel great. Totally worth it and sehr schön.

reviews.t: 5.0 out of 5 starsExcellent Gift & Super Relaxing!
reviews.x: My husband bought these for me for the holidays and I am officially addicted. I'm about to order a refill because I went through the first pack so quickly. The bombs are so great on my skin - I came out of the bath super soft and my skin stayed moisturized for another day or so after. I am usually not a huge fan of overpowering perfumes, but these bombs were gentle and really calming. I especially liked the Garden of the Gods (lavender) and the Sinus Congestion Relief (green). All were super rel

reviews.t: so I was a little worried they wouldn't be that great. Boy was I wrong
reviews.x: These were a little smaller than I expected them to be, so I was a little worried they wouldn't be that great. Boy was I wrong!  They were very fragrant and I left the bath feeling luxurious.  I could even still smell the scent after sweating through a three hour derby practice the next morning.
Smaller than expected, and didn't really make the bath smell strongly or change colors. Just alright.
Very fragrant but rather small. Maybe it should be advertised as "Mini Bombs".

These are purely okay. I am a little disappointed in the quality; these were shipped with several other item which arrived covered in colorful dust from the bath bombs. There also seems to be no difference in the different bombs other than the colors. I expected each one to be a little different, but that sadly isn't the case. I will enjoy what I have, but I would not purchase this item again in the future.

I've only tried one so far. It was quite fragrant and made my body smell good even after a shower right after my bath. It also showed me how bad I am at cleaning my bath tub. :| There is only one bad thing about them. The colors kind of mix together, so it's hard to tell which one is which.

I got these for my best friend for Christmas- she loves them and says they smell and make her smell amazing. She also told me that they don't stain, which, obviously is a great thing. The scent lasts a long time and so do the bubbles. Very glad I bought her these!

These bath bombs are awesome! When i got them they had some dust from other bombs on them from shipping, which i expected, i just took a make up brush to dust them off so the smells wouldn't be too mixed, other wise they were perfectly great on arrival. I do wish that there was a list or something that said what each one was sented with, thought i did like the names of them. I put one in my tub and it worked just as it should, the smells are really good not to much and not too many mixed smells,

I did not care for these bath bombs. I knew from other reviews to not expect a Lush-quality bath bomb, so in that respect, these bath bombs lived up to the reviews. The scent of the bombs is quite strong and lingers. The aroma was too strong for my personal preference, but the lasting scent would be a positive for someone who enjoys a strong aroma. The color imparted was very light. The bath water was tinted lightly with the color of the bath bomb. I made the mistake of storing these on the bath

reviews.t: These bath bombs are awesome. They don't fill the tub with solid color
reviews.x: These bath bombs are awesome. They don't fill the tub with solid color, but it's enough to tell the difference. They smell great, and they make your skin feel sooo good and soft. I usually start sneezing around a lot of fragrance, but not with these, and for other ladies--don't worry about them irritating your more sensitive areas. These are made with great ingredients.

I cut these in half so I got 12 uses instead of 6 which worked awesomely. No staining of the tub, made my skin super soft but no scent left on my skin which was ok. Not exactly overwhelming on the scents and they all kind of blended together. I suggest the maker wrap each one separately so as to keep the scents separate.

reviews.t: not good at all) and 3 of the 6 balls came ...
reviews.x: Some of the scents are a bit off putting (read: not good at all) and 3 of the 6 balls came significantly crumbled up. I realize some of this is due to the shipping--but the other items in the box were unscathed, so it can't have been THAT much of a bumpy ride.

These things were shipped SUPER fast, and they make the entire bathroom smell pleasant. They also leave your skin super soft and with a nice scent. I used all six with in 2 weeks I am a little obsessed, I think.

I ordered both the naughty and natural set, and I love these! They're all one color, so if you're looking for a show these aren't for you, but the scents are really nice and linger on my skin for a while.

Great smell and quality! Only thing I was not happy with is one of my bath bombs had gotten crushed in shipping and spilt all over my other products, but other than that the bombs them selves are awesome
Smelled amazing, but didn't last long I had to use 2 in one bath. If you're looking for a bubble bath or a bath that smells great the whole time you're in it these aren't what you're looking for.
My first bath bombs ever. Did not stain the hotel tub and me and my husband sat there and used all of them one after the other in one sitting. Had amazing smells. Will deffinitely buy again.
I gave them to my niece for her birthday she really enjoyed them and said they smelled nice she just wished I would've gave her more of them she loves them fantastic product
These were bought for my teenage daughter who really liked them.  The only disappointment she had was the pink was too light and didn't change the color of the bath water.

reviews.t: In Love! Hubby and I are ttc for baby #1 ...
reviews.x: In Love! Hubby and I are ttc for baby #1 and this just added that extra bit of mmpf to an already great experience.. They smell amazing! Will be ordering continuously!
Vibrant color and scent. Even tho they are small they pack a powerful punch. I'm a bath bomb conessuir...Definitely happy with my purchase. Recommended to everyone.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the pleasant, long-lasting fragrance and how it leaves skin smelling good.
Several reviewers note the bath bombs are smaller than expected.
Multiple reviewers say the bombs make skin feel soft and moisturized.
Some reviewers report weak or minimal color payoff in the bath.
A few reviewers mention staining or colorful dust from shipping, though others report no staining.
